name: Bioelectric networks as the software plane of morphology

mentions.name: Bioelectric networks as the software plane of morphology
mentions.description: This long-term read-and-think project explores bioelectric networks as the software plane of morphology, following work from the Allen Center, the Levin labs, and TAME (such as the linked arXiv paper). The author has tracked this line of research for five or six years, and it informed a long-form essay on consciousness written for an essay contest.
